from pathlib import Path
from functools import partial
import hashlib
import json
import statistics
import types

import mlx.core as mx
from bench.bench_mlx import _case, _measure
from silkern.contract import localize_reference
from silkern.mlx import localize_mlx
from silkern.mlx_verify import _metadata

source_path = Path('silkern/mlx.py').resolve()
source = source_path.read_text()
axis_x_source = source.replace('threadgroup_position_in_grid.y', 'threadgroup_position_in_grid.x').replace('grid=(256, batch, 1)', 'grid=(batch * 256, 1, 1)')
axis_x = types.ModuleType('silkern_axis_x_diagnostic')
exec(compile(axis_x_source, str(source_path), 'exec'), axis_x.__dict__)
stream = mx.default_stream(mx.gpu)
report = {'diagnostic': 'paired dispatch-axis comparison; only grid and row coordinate differ',
          'metadata': _metadata(mx),
          'prototype_sha256': hashlib.sha256(axis_x_source.encode()).hexdigest(),
          'script': Path(__file__).read_text(),
          'warmup': 10, 'blocks': 12, 'iterations': 50, 'cells': []}
geometry = dict(block_size=64, dcp_size=2, dcp_rank=0)
for batch, width in [(1, 2048), (32, 128), (8, 4096)]:
    requests, pages, rows = _case(width, batch, 64, 2, 17)
    arrays = tuple(mx.array(data, dtype=mx.int32) for data in (requests, pages, rows))
    mx.eval(arrays)
    expected = localize_reference(requests, pages, rows, **geometry)
    arms = {}
    for name, function in [('axis_x', axis_x.localize_mlx), ('axis_y', localize_mlx)]:
        compiled = mx.compile(partial(function, **geometry, backend='metal', stream=stream))
        out, counts = compiled(*arrays)
        mx.eval(out, counts)
        assert (out.tolist(), counts.tolist()) == expected
        invalid = mx.full((batch, width), -1, dtype=mx.int32)
        out2, counts2 = compiled(arrays[0], arrays[1], invalid)
        assert out2.tolist() == [[-1] * width] * batch
        assert counts2.tolist() == [0] * batch
        arms[name] = partial(compiled, *arrays)
    samples, schedule = _measure(mx, arms, warmup=10, iterations=50, blocks=12, stream=stream)
    medians = {arm: statistics.median(values) for arm, values in samples.items()}
    report['cells'].append({'batch': batch, 'width': width, 'seed': 17,
                            'geometry': geometry, 'oracle_passed': True,
                            'median_us': medians, 'block_samples_us': samples,
                            'schedule': schedule})
    print(batch, width, medians, flush=True)
Path('evidence/09-apple-mlx-consumer/dispatch-axis-diagnostic.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2)+'\n')
